summary: Comprehensive testing of dental clinic website template completed. Backend API fully functional with 100% success rate. Frontend loads correctly with all sections, proper design implementation, and working admin integration. Minor UI interaction issues found with dropdown selections in booking form.

ui_bugs.issue: Service and time dropdown options not clickable via Playwright (visibility detection issue)
ui_bugs.note: Form fields exist and dropdowns open, but automated selection fails. Manual testing required to confirm if this affects real users.

passed_tests: Homepage loading with all required sections
Navigation functionality (navbar links, Book Now buttons)
Mobile responsive design and mobile menu
Font implementation (Manrope for headings, DM Sans for body)
Placeholder text display ([Clinic Name], [Doctor Name], etc.)
action_item_for_main_agent: Address dropdown selection UI issue in booking form. While dropdowns open correctly, automated testing cannot select options due to visibility detection. This may not affect real users but should be verified with manual testing or alternative dropdown implementation.
